## Simple interest {#fm2-formula .fm-slide }

::: {.takeaway}
$$I=PRN$$
:::

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $P$ | Principal: the original amount |
| $R$ | Rate per time period, as a decimal |
| $N$ | Number of those time periods |
| $I$ | Interest earned |

<p class="small-note">The rate and time must use the same period.</p>

<p class="small-note">Total value of the investment = original principal + interest.</p>

::: notes
Booklet §2.1, p. 5. Each period's simple interest is based on the original principal. Distinguish a payment of interest from reinvestment; no compound growth is assumed.
:::
